moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred men's and women's cricket tournaments are in full swing across the UK, with matches today including Birmingham Phoenix vs Welsh Fire and London Spirit vs Southern Brave.

source.l: The Hundred Official Site / Radio Times

angles.name: Match Day Hype
angles.copy: Game on! The Hundred action continues today with Birmingham Phoenix taking on Welsh Fire at Edgbaston, plus London Spirit face Southern Brave at Lord's. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Local Team Focus (Welsh Fire)
angles.copy: It's a big day for Welsh Fire in The Hundred! Tune in to see them battle Birmingham Phoenix. C'mon the Fire!

moments.title: Commonwealth Games Netball Bronze
moments.blurb: England's netball team, the Roses, will play for the bronze medal at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow tomorrow, following their semi-final defeat to New Zealand today.

angles.name: Bronze Medal Match Preview
angles.copy: Tough loss for the Roses today, but they're still fighting for a medal! England netball go for bronze tomorrow at the Commonwealth Games. Let's get behind them! 🥉

angles.name: Glasgow Games Buzz
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games in Glasgow are winding down, but not before England's netball team aim for bronze tomorrow. What a run it's been!

moments.title: Lewis Hall to Man Utd Transfer Speculation
moments.blurb: Manchester United are reportedly exploring a move for Newcastle United left-back Lewis Hall, with a potential £60m valuation being discussed as the Premier League transfer window heats up.

angles.name: Transfer Rumour Mill
angles.copy: Another day, another huge transfer rumour! Man Utd are reportedly eyeing Newcastle's Lewis Hall for a massive £60m. Would he be a good fit?

angles.name: Newcastle Fan Reaction
angles.copy: Could Newcastle lose Lewis Hall to Man Utd? Magpies fans, how would you feel about a £60m move for the defender?

moments.title: Exeter City Striker Rumours
moments.blurb: Exeter City boss Matt Taylor has confirmed the club has received no bids for prolific striker Jayden Wareham, amidst social media speculation linking him to Plymouth Argyle.

angles.name: Local Football Update
angles.copy: Good news for Exeter City fans! Boss Matt Taylor says there have been no bids for star striker Jayden Wareham. Keeping him at St James Park?

angles.name: Devon Derby Chatter
angles.copy: The rumour mill was buzzing about Jayden Wareham and Plymouth Argyle, but Exeter City say no bids have come in. Your thoughts, Devon football fans?

moments.title: Edinburgh Festivals Kick Off Next Week
moments.blurb: The world-renowned Edinburgh Festival Fringe and Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo both begin next Friday, August 7th, bringing a month of arts, comedy, music, and spectacular shows to the Scottish capital.

angles.name: Fringe Hype
angles.copy: Edinburgh is about to get even livelier! The Fringe and Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo start next Friday. Who's heading to Scotland for the biggest arts festival on Earth?

angles.name: Scottish Spotlight
angles.copy: Get ready, Scotland! The Edinburgh Festival Fringe kicks off in just one week, promising a huge month of culture and entertainment. What are you most excited to see?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Break Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's duet 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history, becoming the longest-running No.1 single ever with 19 weeks at the top, surpassing a 73-year-old record set by Frankie Laine.

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK No.1 single ever! 19 weeks at the top! Incredible stuff. 🎉

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: Out with Frankie Laine, in with Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' has smashed a 73-year record to become the UK's longest-running No.1. Have you streamed it today?

angles.name: Song of the Year
angles.copy: From BRITs Song of the Year to all-time chart record breaker! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are on fire with 'Rein Me In'. What a track!

moments.title: Shakira & Burna Boy's World Cup Anthem at No. 2
moments.blurb: Shakira & Burna Boy's official FIFA World Cup 2026 anthem 'Dai Dai' holds strong at No. 2 on the UK Singles Chart, following its performance at the World Cup final halftime show.

angles.name: Chart Contender
angles.copy: Still a massive hit! Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is holding strong at #2 on the Official Singles Chart. Did you catch their World Cup performance?

angles.name: World Cup Anthem
angles.copy: The World Cup may be over, but the anthem lives on! Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is still dominating the charts. What a banger!

moments.title: Happy 68th to Ian Broudie
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, the mastermind behind The Lightning Seeds, celebrates his 68th birthday on Tuesday, August 4th.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Get your 'Lucky You' on! Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds turns 68 on Tuesday. What's your favourite Lightning Seeds track?

angles.name: 90s Icon
angles.copy: Happy almost birthday to 90s legend Ian Broudie! The man behind The Lightning Seeds hits 68 this Tuesday. Still got that indie pop magic!

moments.title: Happy 64th to Paul Reynolds
moments.blurb: Paul Reynolds, the lead guitarist of 80s new wave band A Flock Of Seagulls, celebrates his 64th birthday on Tuesday, August 4th.

angles.name: 80s Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 64th birthday to Paul Reynolds of A Flock Of Seagulls this Tuesday! What an 80s icon!

angles.name: New Wave Classic
angles.copy: It's Paul Reynolds' birthday on Tuesday! The lead guitarist from A Flock Of Seagulls, known for those distinctive riffs, turns 64. Time to play 'I Ran'!

moments.title: Happy 29th to Yungblud
moments.blurb: British rock and alternative star Yungblud (Dominic Harrison) celebrates his 29th birthday on Wednesday, August 5th.

angles.name: Modern Rock Star
angles.copy: Big birthday coming up for Yungblud! The Doncaster star turns 29 this Wednesday. What's your favourite track from him?

angles.name: Gen Z Icon
angles.copy: Happy 29th to the one and only Yungblud this Wednesday! An absolute force in modern music. Let's celebrate with some loud tunes!

moments.title: Happy 67th to Pat Smear
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist Pat Smear, known for his work with Foo Fighters, Nirvana, and The Germs, celebrates his 67th birthday on Wednesday, August 5th.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a huge happy 67th birthday to the incredible Pat Smear this Wednesday! From The Germs to Nirvana to Foo Fighters, what a career!

angles.name: Foo Fighters Legend
angles.copy: Happy 67th to Foo Fighters' own Pat Smear on Wednesday! A true legend of punk and rock. What's your favourite Foos song?

moments.title: Scottish Summer Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: Scotland celebrates its Summer Bank Holiday this Monday, August 3rd, providing a long weekend for many across the nation.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes (Scotland)
angles.copy: Happy Summer Bank Holiday weekend, Scotland! Enjoy that extra day off this Monday. What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Relax and Recharge
angles.copy: Monday means a long weekend for our listeners in Scotland! Make the most of your Summer Bank Holiday. How are you relaxing?
